text:
olivia: Heads-up — Deploybot quarantined rc4 artifacts during preflight: missing SBOM cosign signature + a single transitive MEDIUM vuln found. Change window in ~2h. tagging @deploybot @legal-bot :eyes:

deploybot: automated: action=quarantine reason=sbom_missing,vuln_flag count=1 severity=MEDIUM pipeline=release/rc4 workflow=preflight

raj: quick check — running cosign verify against the artifact now. if builder used KMS the proof should be in cosign blob (sig.json).

mike: if we can get KMS attestation + cosign proof and an exploitability note, legal can sign off for a limited canary. otherwise rollback to rc3 is on the table.

olivia: @mike who on infra owns pulling the cosign proof from the build cluster? we need timestamped blob and builder key-id.

mike: i can fetch it. command i'll run:```bash
cosign verify-blob --signature artifacts/rc4.sig --blob artifacts/rc4.tar.gz --key k8s://projects/redwood-kms/keys/build-key-01
```

sophia: options laid out: A) allow 5% NA canary only with carveout + mitigation ticket, pending proof upload within 30m. B) full rollback to rc3. C) emergency pin of transitive dep + staggered rollout.

dylan: release-notes update: add a note in the candidate about the transitive lib and planned mitigation. if we go with A we must add the mitigation and JIRA link before canary.

legal-bot: please provide CVE ID and an exploitability summary. legal approval requires either: exploitability=low OR documented mitigation + risk owner sign-off.

raj: verified output (snip):```
artifact: sha256:3f8a7c...
cosign-status: OK
key-id: projects/redwood-kms/keys/build-key-01
sign-time: 2026-03-21T12:07:33Z
provenance: missing-attestation 
```

mike: cosign proof shows signature valid but provenance attestation not present from the builder pipeline. i'm uploading sig + digest to the release artifacts area now: artifacts/rc4/signature-proof.tar.gz

olivia: thanks. legal, raj, can you confirm whether the signature validity + uploaded artifact is sufficient, or do we need the attestation from the build job (rekord attestation)?

legal-bot: signature OK but absence of provenance attestation is noted. risk owner must accept residual risk. tagging @sophia as risk owner.

sophia: i accept limited risk for NA canary with these constraints: 1) 5% traffic NA only, 2) mitigation ticket RL-1234 created + linked in release notes, 3) proof (sig+digest) uploaded, 4) rollback/kill criteria documented. 30m window to upload the missing attestation or we rollback.

olivia: sounds good. canary carveout approved for NA 5% pending artifact attach. @deploybot — lift quarantine for canary only when RL-1234 is linked and proof present.

deploybot: automated: quarantine_lifted_for_canary scope=na_percent=5 conditions=[rl_ticket=RL-1234, proof_uploaded=true] timestamp=5109876842

dylan: i'll update release notes and the canary runbook. adding the rollback triggers and monitoring dashboards. :thumbsup:

mike: uploaded cosign proof + a short note on why attestation missing (legacy builder image needs an update). PR to fix builder pipeline opened: infra#452.

olivia: thanks everyone. tracking: RL-1234 created, infra#452 to add provenance attestation, canary started. if exploitability escalates we roll back immediately.
